patch_description: Replace the three-level hierarchical pipeline (group→node packing, node-local replication, node-local GPU packing) with a flat, direct two-stage scheme: (1) decide replica counts per logical expert with a greedy loop that always replicates the expert with the highest per-replica load (weight/logcnt), and (2) build a flat list of all physical replicas (each with load weight/logcnt), sort them descending, and run one batched LPT `balanced_packing` across *all* GPUs. This removes the intermediate node constraint that forced heavy experts to stay within a node's expert budget, so the greedy LPT sees the whole GPU pool and both the expert-level loads (weight/logcnt) and the GPU-level loads are directly minimized by the same LPT that already scored well (0.66 gpu balancedness). Post-replication loads feeding LPT (instead of the naive load/count ratio heuristic deciding placement) directly target the weakest metric, expert balancedness. The algorithm is also simpler: one replication loop + one LPT pass instead of two LPT passes plus gather/scatter plumbing, so execution time stays small.
